name: Carcinoma of unknown primary
theme: the diagnosis that is a process · tissue-of-origin meets the panel era

meta.title: Cancer of unknown primary in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Cancer of unknown primary (CUP) - metastatic carcinoma with no identifiable primary after standardized workup
meta.population: Adults with CUP - THE DIAGNOSIS THAT IS A PROCESS: a carcinoma proven metastatic whose primary survives a standardized hunt (ESMO CPG verified, PMID 36563965 - a 2023 guideline on a 2022 PubMed record, the dating trap noted). ~1-2% of cancers and FALLING (verified: 'historically 3-5%... decreased to 1-2%'; UK incidence down 62% since the early 1990s - better diagnostics shrink the category). THE DENOMINATOR CORRECTION (44th) ships on every survival line: population registries put all-comers median OS near 3 MONTHS (verified, 'no improvement over time') while the familiar 6-12-month figures are TRIAL-population numbers - this trainer says which denominator every figure uses. THE FAVORABLE SUBSETS (~20%, verified framework) are the classic curriculum - each treated as its putative primary, each a routing decision into a LIVE trainer of this registry - and THE SIGNATURE IS THE SPLIT VERDICT (correction 41st): classifier-guided site-specific therapy lost its first two randomized trials (GEFCAPI 04 - abstract-only, the no-full-paper trap; Hayashi - whose site-specific arm was numerically WORSE, 1-yr OS 44.0% vs 54.9%, correction 42nd) and then WON one (Fudan CUP-001, Lancet Oncol 2024: PFS 9.6 vs 6.6 - single-centre, PFS endpoint, caveats carried) - while CUPISCO (THE LANCET, not Nature - correction 40th) rewrote the unfavorable chapter from the molecular side: molecularly guided therapy beat continued chemo (PFS 6.1 vs 4.4, HR 0.72) in the ~32% with actionable alterations. The field flipped in one month - July-August 2024, two journals, two weeks apart.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the diagnosis that is a process. THE ARCHITECTURE IS A ROUTING TABLE: a declared primary exits the trainer (gate reroute to the registry index - the nineteenth live reroute, and the first that points at ALL the others); non-carcinoma mimics (lymphoma / melanoma / sarcoma by IHC) block out to their own workups; and the favorable subsets are taught as routes into LIVE registry trainers - isolated axillary disease to the breast trainer's logic (modern occult-breast series: 5-yr OS ~93%, cited as the favorable surgical series they are), squamous cervical n…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: ESMO CPG 2023 (verified) + NCCN Occult Primary (memory-grade): favorable subsets (isolated axillary [female] / squamous cervical-node [p16-EBER-routed] / peritoneal serous [female] / blastic-bone+PSA [male] / midline germ-cell-suspect / single resectable metastasis / NET-CUP / and the 2023 additions: colon-like, renal-like, lung-like) vs unfavorable CUP; the IHC cascade (CK7/CK20 quadrants + organ markers, verified receipts) as the sorter; CGP-at-diagnosis the modern default for unfavorable disease
meta.response: Imaging response conventions; the workup itself is the first therapeutic act - and a declared primary EXITS the diagnosis (the trainer reroutes to the registry)

refs.label: THE FRAMEWORK, verified: ESMO Clinical Practice Guideline (Kramer/Bochtler/Pauli, Ann Oncol 2023;34:228-246 - PMID 36563965, pubmed-url-match; THE DATING TRAP: a 2023 guideline on a 2022 PubMed record, epub 2022-12-21). Favorable subsets enumerated (~20%): NET-CUP, peritoneal serous (F), isolated axillary (F), squamous cervical-node, colorectal-profile (CK20+CDX2+CK7-), single metastasis, blastic-bone/PSA (M) - PLUS the 2023 additions (colon-like, renal-like, lung-like); AFP/bHCG germ-cell screen verified verbatim; CGP-at-diagnosis trend. NCCN Occult Primary exists (memory-grade, paywalled) | PMID 36563965 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

EPI + THE DENOMINATOR CORRECTION (44th): ~1-2% of cancers and FALLING (verified: 'historically 3-5%... decreased to 1-2%'; CRUK: UK incidence down 62% since early 1990s). MEDIAN OS BY DENOMINATOR: population-based ~3 MONTHS all-comers, 'no improvement over time' (PMID 22115926, pubmed-url-match); trial/clinic-referred unfavorable 6-12 months; favorable subsets = their putative primaries' curves. Every survival sentence names its denominator | PMID 22115926 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE IHC CASCADE, verified: 'Immunohistochemistry for Diagnosis of Metastatic Carcinomas of Unknown Primary Site' (Selves, Cancers 2018 - PMID 29621151, pubmed-url-match): CK7/CK20 coordinate quadrants + organ markers (PAX8/TTF-1/GATA3/CDX2/mammaglobin/PSA/uroplakin; p40 squamous convention); one validated algorithm: sensitivity 80.3%, specificity 97.6% (9 subsets, 15 markers) | PMID 29621151 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

GEFCAPI 04 - NEGATIVE, with THE NO-FULL-PAPER TRAP: gene-expression site-specific vs empiric cisplatin-gemcitabine (n=243) - PFS 5.8 vs 6.4 months, HR 0.95 (0.72-1.25), no OS difference (~10 months) - quoted from the ESMO 2019 ABSTRACT (Fizazi, Ann Oncol 2019;30 suppl 5:v851, LBA15_PR) because NO full peer-reviewed paper exists; anyone citing 'Fizazi, JCO' is inventing a reference; the mOS pair is truncated in every snippet and NOT quoted beyond 'no difference'
refs.src: ESMO abstract (the only citable form; trap documented)

refs.label: HAYASHI - NEGATIVE AND NUMERICALLY WORSE (correction 42nd), verified: 'Randomized Phase II Trial Comparing Site-Specific Treatment Based on Gene Expression Profiling With Carboplatin and Paclitaxel...' (JCO 2019;37:570-579 - PMID 30653423, pubmed-url-match): 1-yr OS 44.0% site-specific vs 54.9% empiric (50 vs 51 pts) - the stronger teaching point than 'null'; top predicted primaries: pancreas 21%, gastric 21%, LYMPHOMA 20% (the sorter-humility receipt) | PMID 30653423 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

FUDAN CUP-001 - THE POSITIVE THAT REOPENED THE QUESTION (correction 41st), verified: 'Site-specific therapy guided by a 90-gene expression assay versus empirical chemotherapy...' (Lancet Oncol 2024;25(8) - PMID 39068945, pubmed-url-match): PFS 9.6 vs 6.6 months favoring site-specific - CAVEATS CARRIED: single-centre (Fudan Shanghai), previously untreated, PFS endpoint, OS secondary and (memory-grade) not significant. Two negatives and a positive make a QUESTION - taught as one | PMID 39068945 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

CUPISCO - THE PANEL-ERA REWRITE (correction 40th: THE LANCET 2024;404:527-539, NOT Nature; cited by DOI - the PMID unclaimed this sweep, never remembered into existence): molecularly guided therapy vs continued chemo after 3-cycle induction with disease control (436 randomized 3:1; 159 ex-US sites) - PFS 6.1 (4.7-6.5) vs 4.4 (4.1-5.6), HR 0.72 (0.56-0.92), p=0.0079; interim OS 14.7 vs 11.0 (not definitive); ~32% actionable (verified verbatim; baseline-profiles paper 37922692, matched). THE PUSHBACK CARRIED: open-label, 3:1, PFS endpoint, benefit in the actionable third - 'practice-informing, not practice-settling' (Lancet Oncol editorial). CLOSED; NO successor exists | PMID 39096924 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE TUMOR-AGNOSTIC DOOR LIST (CUP's real approvals - verified current): pembrolizumab MSI-H/dMMR (2017) + TMB>=10 (2020-06-16, FDA-verified); dostarlimab dMMR (2021-08-17); larotrectinib (2018) / entrectinib (2019) / repotrectinib (2024-06-13 - NOT 2023) NTRK; selpercatinib RET (2022-09 accelerated; converted to TRADITIONAL approval 2026-07-14 - refresh); dabrafenib+trametinib BRAF V600E (2022-06; not CRC); T-DXd HER2 IHC3+ (2024-04-05 - 'first tumor-agnostic HER2 therapy'). 'As of January 2025, 8 regimens' (verified snippet; review 39061168, matched). NOTHING ADDED 2025-2026 (weak absence, web-only). DISTRACTORS DOCUMENTED: zongertinib = NSCLC-only; zenocutuzumab = NRG1 indication-by-indication (NSCLC/pancreatic + cholangiocarcinoma 2026-05) - NOT agnostic | PMID 39061168 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE EMPIRIC BACKBONE (verified band): platinum + taxane/gemcitabine - ORR 20-40%, mOS 9-12 months TRIAL-denominator (paclitaxel-carboplatin arm: ORR 23.8%, mOS 11.0, 1-yr 38%; Greco/Hainsworth gem-carbo-taxol: n=120, ORR 25%, mOS 9); GEFCAPI 02 (cisplatin +/- gemcitabine - PMID 22317952, pubmed-url-match): no practice-changing winner. The 1990s numbers labeled as such | PMID 22317952 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE FAVORABLE-ROW OUTCOMES at their own grades: occult-breast axillary - MODERN series 5-yr OS ~93% / DFS 92-96% (PMID 34619827, pubmed-url-match + 17690561, matched) - favorable SURGICAL series, cited as such, never generic-CUP; extragonadal germ-cell - seminoma ~90% cure; mediastinal nonseminomatous 40-50% 5-yr; the CUP-flavored classic (Hainsworth/Greco poorly-differentiated 12-yr experience - PMID 1375284, matched): >50% responses, 10-15% CURES - the most curable miss, never sold as testicular-level | PMID 34619827 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

refs.label: THE CERVICAL-NODE ROUTER, verified: ASCO 'Diagnosis and Management of Squamous Cell Carcinoma of Unknown Primary in the Head and Neck' (Maghami, JCO 2020 - ascopubs-verified); ESMO: 'P16 IHC and EBER-ISH recommended for ALL cervical lymph nodes with carcinoma of unknown primary' (verified snippet) - p16+/EBV- -> oropharynx-directed; EBV+/HPV- -> nasopharynx-directed - two stains routing to the head-neck trainer's HPV fork

THE RESOLUTION LEDGER (one number, one source - the era-mixing trap avoided): autopsy identified the primary in 73% (n=644; lung 27%, pancreas 24% of those found - PMC-verified); the classic 302-pt series (PMID 3046543, matched): alive 27% / autopsy 57% / never 16%; the benchmark-shift paper (Pentheroudakis, 'Switching benchmarks... from autopsy to microarray' - 17698346, matched); modern ante-mortem declaration ~20-25% (memory-grade, flagged soft)

THE IO RECORD at exact grade (correction 43rd): NivoCUP (Japan, n=56): pretreated ORR 22.2% -> JAPAN approval 2021-12 (ONO-verified) - NEVER a US door; CUPem (NCT03752333, Imperial): pretreated ORR 20.0%, mPFS 4.1, mOS 11.3 (completed, results 2026-05) - THE NAME-CONFLATION TRAP: at least three pembro-CUP phase 2s circulate (CUPem; the MDACC ctDNA study 35618285; the 2026 EJC UNTREATED study - ORR 11.1%, MISSED its endpoint) - cite by NCT; CheCUP (nivo+ipi, TMB-stratified): ORR 16% overall, 60% TMB-high vs 7.7% TMB-low, terminated early (Nat Commun 2023) - the signal points where the agnostic label already stands. NO randomized IO-vs-chemo CUP trial anywhere (desert verified) | PMID 34843940 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE METHYLATION/ctDNA DESERT, verified: CUPiD (cfDNA methylation, 29 classes - Nat Commun 2024): prediction in 78% of 41 CUP pts, 88.5% clinically consistent; ToO accuracy 96.8% - RETROSPECTIVE/pilot; the prospective trial is 'next steps' and NOT found running; EPICUP (tissue methylation, 87%) never prospectively tested for management; EGGCUP (UK) is OBSERVATIONAL; CRONUS (Kindai, ctDNA CSO) abstract-stage; WGS-for-ToO 2025 receipts exist (40393956, matched) - promising, unproven-for-management. No prospective management-changing trial anywhere

THE CENSUS: MD Anderson atezolizumab+tiragolumab (NCT06754501 - the ONE US CUP-specific door; status RESOLVED: active-not-recruiting per 2026-02 update - a results-watch, not a door); DART CUP cohort (NCT02834013 - accrual status UNVERIFIED); ComboMATCH per-substudy (CUP not explicitly named); TAPUR alteration-based; EX-US: NorCUP (NCT07366008, Norway, not-yet-recruiting, design unknown), Lu-177 FAP-2286 CUP (NCT07434180, Australia), EGGCUP (NCT06695494, UK, observational). CUPISCO CLOSED, no successor. DESERTS: no US randomized CUP trial; no randomized IO-vs-chemo

JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.
